review_findings.title: Custom listbox trigger omits the selected value from its accessible name
review_findings.details: In src/App.tsx ArenaListbox, aria-labelledby={labelId} on the trigger overrides the button's descendant text, so assistive technology may announce only the Task/Case label and not the selected option or placeholder. Add a stable value element id and include the label plus value in the accessible name (or an equivalent standards-compliant approach) while retaining visible text and user-content escaping.

review_findings.title: Static UI contracts omit the Models responsive fallback
review_findings.details: The new scripts/ui-contracts.test.mjs checks Arena comparison/live overflow and reduced motion, but the prompt's layout testing expectation also requires the Models desktop-to-narrow behavior. Add a focused static contract assertion for .models-layout and .model-row switching to one column in the max-width:900px media block, without inventing a browser harness.
